claims.text: The authors experimented with CNN/DailyMail to evaluate the effectiveness of their HiStruct+ models in producing competitive results for extractive summarization.
The motivation for using CNN/DailyMail was to compare their model's performance against strong baselines and to investigate the contributions of hierarchical position information.
The authors aimed to show that their model works better on datasets with conspicuous hierarchical structures, which is evident from the results on CNN/DailyMail.
